mira_pm: Quick thread  we need a clear, customer-shareable pilot rubric for the Optimize toolkit that includes batching, caching, quantization recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Goal: one internal checklist + one short customer one-pager.
devin_eng: Proposed high-level gates: 1) Economics: net token cost reduction >= 7% over canary, 2) Latency: p95 steady-state within target and >=12% improvement for batching cases, 3) Quality: per-customer primary eval metric delta <= 0.02 absolute.
lee_prod: Add a compliance/privacy gate for Private tenants: no telemetry leaves VPC and KMS logs enabled. Also add an explicit "manual hold" flow for customers with regulatory constraints.
ana_research: For quality we should allow a small multi-metric rule: if customers have N metrics, require at most 1 metric to degrade >0.02 and the aggregate metric (weighted) <=0.02. For embeddings we use cosine-concordance delta <= 0.015.
devin_eng: Operational canary plan (recommended): phased rollout: phase A 1% for 6h, phase B 5% for 24h, phase C 20% for 48h; abort if any gate fails. Canary must include synthetic load + representative customer sample where possible.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window available 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Auto-rollback enabled by default.
lee_prod: Eval-alert tuning: initial alert window 14d, max_regressions=5, quality_delta_threshold=0.02; after two weeks, tighten if noise < 20% of alerts. Example YAML for ops: ```yaml
alert_eval_regressions:
  window_days: 14
  max_regressions: 5
quality_delta_threshold: 0.02
embed_concordance_threshold: 0.015
```
devin_eng: Fallbacks: 1) quant recs must include a tagged higher-precision variant to fallback to on any runtime errors, 2) cache-disabled path if cache hit rate < 10% in canary, 3) auto-pause if customer-level error rate increases by >0.5% absolute.
nana_research: Add a statistical check: require p-value > 0.05 that observed quality change is within noise model, otherwise treat as regression even if delta small. This helps catch sudden distribution shifts.
lee_prod: Customer one-pager should be simple: what we change, why, how to opt-out, how to pin a model, who to contact, what alerts look like. Include an FAQ on quantization tradeoffs and an example timeline for the phased canary.
devin_eng: Acceptance test (internal): run full canary sequence with monitoring panels showing per-tenant cost delta, p95/p99 steady-state, eval-delta time series. Pass criteria: econ <= -7% (i.e., at least 7% savings), latency gate met, quality gate met, no auto-rollbacks triggered. Any failed gate -> immediate rollback + postmortem.
ops-bot: Suggested automated checks to wire into runbook: KV cache hit ratio, per-tenant token-cost delta, eval-regression counter, latency steady-state monitor (starts after 5m warm-up).
nana_research: For customers without eval sets, fall back to conservative defaults: quality_delta_threshold = 0.01 and max_regressions=2, plus require an extended canary (72h at 5%).
devin_eng: Decision matrix idea: GREEN if all gates pass; AMBER if economics+latency pass but quality borderline (<=8 regressions/28d) -> extend canary and require manual sign-off; RED -> rollback. Log decisions in deployment audit.
lee_prod: Also include a lightweight dashboard tile for product: per-pilot snapshot with green/amber/red and links to logs, eval diffs, and cost breakdown.
devin_eng: Note on autoscaling: batching increases concurrency; ensure autoscaler limits are tuned so burst scaling doesn't inflate p99 during phase transitions. Measure steady-state p99 after 3m warm-up and compare to SLO; allow 15% overshoot during warm-up only.
nana_research: I'll produce a short blurb for the customer one-pager about "how we measure quality" with examples for classification, chat concordance, and embeddings so customers can map their metrics.
lee_prod: Who will create the internal checklist doc and the customer one-pager?
devin_eng: I will open a PR with the checklist + example alert YAML and the phased canary plan by EOD.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: optimize-toolkit/pilot-2026-04-02 (1% -> 5% -> 20%).
mira_pm: Great work. Once PR is up I'll review and we'll ship the one-pager with the pilot invite. Thanks team :raised_hands:
